Mustafa Sagun - Founder and CIO
Description: Mustafa is chief investment officer for Principal Global Equities. He is responsible for overseeing portfolio management and research for all international, domestic, and global equities strategies. Mustafa has managed global equity portfolios since 2002 and has also served as a member of the firm's asset allocation strategy team. He joined the firm in 2000 and has been in the financial services industry since 1991. Prior to his current role, Mustafa was a vice president and [...] ## Experience
- Principal Owner at Aivaly Investment Management and Consulting LLC (Jan 2024 to present)
- Chief Investment Officer, Principal Global Equities at Principal Asset Management (Aug 2000 to Dec 2023)
- avp at PNC Financial Services Group (Jan 1996 to Jan 2000)
- equity derivative specialist at Salomon Brothers (Jan 1995 to Jan 1996)
- assistant professor
